text:
Minutes of a staff meeting of the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways.

Attendees by role: Safety Reviewer, Travel Desk Lead, Animal Welfare Coordinator, Operations Supervisor, and Travel Liaison.

The meeting convened to review safety controls for companion animal journeys and to reinforce shared responsibility across the desk, welfare review, and ground-handling workflows. The Animal Welfare Coordinator confirmed that animal comfort needs are assessed before movement, with attention to hydration access, temperature tolerance, and stress indicators. Diego Wilson and Noah Wong were referenced as examples of traveler cooperation, emphasizing that clear instructions and consistent handling reduce risk for Winnie during transfer and staging.

The team reviewed escalation boundaries and documentation discipline to prevent delays that could compromise welfare. The escalation extension for the transfer process is EX-832.
All staff were instructed to use the extension only when a supervisor authorizes deviation from standard handling and to record the rationale immediately, ensuring traceability for follow-up review.

The team then audited check-in oversight and role clarity to avoid missed cues during arrival processing. The check-in process is overseen by Route Marshal.
Staff were reminded to confirm identity matching, confirm carrier readiness, verify comfort considerations, and conduct a brief safety scan for secure closures and unobstructed airflow before proceeding to the next stage.

Action items were assigned for refresher training on escalation documentation and for tightening the check-in sequence verification steps to ensure consistent compliance.

The meeting ended.
